name: Mysterious Man
source:
A mysterious individual with a huge muscular frame and seven scars on his chest. Legend has it that the circle he comes to at ComiPa will rise to the top.

[spoiler] His name is Tachikawa Yuzou, and he's [url=https://vndb.org/c78620]Ikumi'[/url]s older brother.  Yuzou comes to the KomiPa venue on his sister's behalf and often appears in front of Kazuki, who his sister is interested in.
